Bose family heritage · Rarikhal

About this place

Banglapedia identifies Rarikhal as the Bose family’s ancestral village. It records his birth in Mymensingh. His experiments on electromagnetic waves and the responses of living tissues spanned disciplines that are often taught separately. The Rarikhal site offers a local way into that wider scientific life.
